answer: Each new identity must answer a task seeded by a randomly drawn receipt from the prior epoch, so no answer can be precomputed before registering. Cloned keys reuse one cached seed and emit identical receipts, which peers reject as a duplicate node, and the cluster is voided at the first repeated link. Honest standing becomes a haven no purchase can buy, since it accrues only from receipts nobody else shares. A modest oasis of subsidized first slots keeps real newcomers viable, while a farm's unit cost sinks to its nadir: full inference per key, per epoch, with no shortcut.
